scenes.title: Riding at sunrise
scenes.video_prompt: A cinematic imagined historical scene on the Mongolian steppe at sunrise. A Mongol leader inspired by Genghis Khan, wearing a dark fur-trimmed coat, rides a brown horse. The horse trots forward across the grassland, its legs moving naturally. Wind moves the grass, the horse's mane and the rider's clothing. The camera smoothly tracks beside the rider in a medium-wide shot. Warm low sunlight, realistic natural motion, cinematic historical reconstruction, no text or titles.
scenes.narration: An imagined Mongol leader rides across the windswept steppe at sunrise.
